lines.zh: 我慢慢地走，脚几乎不抬。
lines.en: I walk slowly, feet barely lifting.

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊走，不惊动谁。
lines.en: I walk the corridor without disturbing anything.

lines.zh: 我的线在身后拖着一小截。
lines.en: A short length of thread drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我绕过地上的电线，很小心。
lines.en: I step round the wire on the floor. Carefully.
A step, a pause, a listen.

lines.zh: 我朝有光的那边走过去。
lines.en: I walk toward the light.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上比我慢半拍。
lines.en: My shadow lags half a beat behind me.

lines.zh: 我从门缝里过去，门没动。
lines.en: I pass through the gap. The door doesn't move.

lines.zh: 我经过灯下，灯晃了一下。
lines.en: I pass under a lamp and it flickers.

lines.zh: 我走路没什么声音，只有布响。
lines.en: My steps are silent but for the cloth.

lines.zh: 我一步一步量着这块地板。
lines.en: I measure this floor step by step.

lines.zh: 我走到一半，又回头看看。
lines.en: Halfway there, I look back.
I sit on the edge of a crate and hold still.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有变化，一直这样。
lines.en: My eyes don't change. They never do.

lines.zh: 我在看窗外，什么也没有。
lines.en: I look out the window. Nothing there.

lines.zh: 我的线有点松，我扯了扯。
lines.en: A thread's loose. I give it a tug.

lines.zh: 这地方的安静，我习惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to the quiet here.

lines.zh: 有人在楼上走动，我不上去。
lines.en: Someone's walking upstairs. I won't go up.
I put my hands on my knees and wait.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被摆弄，但也不反抗。
lines.en: I don't like being handled. I don't resist either.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，我还是坐在这儿。
lines.en: The light's out. I'm still sitting here.

lines.zh: 我身上有一点旧的味道。
lines.en: There's a stale smell about me.
I'm counting the cracks in the floor.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是缝的，笑不出来。
lines.en: My mouth is stitched. I can't smile.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在响，慢慢地。
lines.en: Something's sounding far off. Slowly.
I don't want to do anything.
You're too near my threads.

lines.zh: 我不是那种会扑上来的。
lines.en: I'm not the sort that lunges.
Reach out and I'll step back.

lines.zh: 我这样坐着，不表示欢迎。
lines.en: Sitting like this isn't a welcome.

lines.zh: 你身上有屋外的冷风味。
lines.en: You carry the cold outside air on you.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的热气，我好久没见。
lines.en: Your warm breath is something I haven't felt in ages.
Don't touch my threads. They break.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿就行，别说太多。
lines.en: Just stand there. Don't talk much.

lines.zh: 我脸上这两笔是画上去的。
lines.en: These features were painted on.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我们就这么待着。
lines.en: Take a step back and we'll stay like this.
A machine behind you has stopped.
I'm not good at reading faces.

lines.zh: 很少有人敢这么坐着看我。
lines.en: Few sit and watch me like this.
Walk where you like here.

lines.zh: 我身上没有能给你的东西。
lines.en: I've nothing on me to give you.
Sit if you want. Don't block the door.

lines.zh: 我听见你呼吸的节奏了。
lines.en: I've got the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 你多看一会儿也没什么。
lines.en: Look as long as you like.
If you go, close the door.
I'll stay here. I won't follow you out.
I step back without a word.
That set my cloth crooked.

lines.zh: 一根缝线崩开，棉花露出来。
lines.en: A seam splits, and stuffing shows.
I don't hurt. I'm just hollow.
I brace on the table and steady myself.
That shook some fluff out.
I look up at you without expression.
I set myself straight.
Breaking me doesn't feel good either, does it.
I sit back down and look away.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，我看看就行。
lines.en: That thing in your hand — I'll just look.
I don't eat. My mouth is stitched.
Leave it on the table. I won't touch it.
That much changes nothing.
I reach, then draw my hand back.
Too high to see it clearly.
I don't want it. Truly.

lines.zh: 这味道我好像在哪儿闻过。
lines.en: I've smelled this somewhere before.
What you set down, I'll leave alone.
Keep it for yourself.

lines.zh: 你这一碰，我身上的线都晃了。
lines.en: That shook every thread on me.
Don't come close. I'm all dust.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪，空出这条道。
lines.en: I shift aside and clear the way.

lines.zh: 这一下我手上的线缠住了。
lines.en: That tangled the thread in my hand.

lines.zh: 我的布被你撞得凹进去。
lines.en: Your bump dented my cloth.
You stepped on my foot. I didn't move.

lines.zh: 碰上的时候，你退了半步。
lines.en: At the touch, you gave half a step.

lines.zh: 这一下我歪了，我扳回来。
lines.en: That set me crooked. I straightened.
You're much stronger than I am.

lines.zh: 别推，我的棉花会散出来。
lines.en: Don't push; my stuffing will spill.

lines.zh: 别靠近，缝线不是用来牵的。
lines.en: Stay back; my seams aren't for holding.

lines.zh: 我是一块布，里面是棉花。
lines.en: I'm cloth with cotton inside.
Come near and I'll only back away.
That would need something I don't have.
I prefer sitting alone.
Put your hand down, then we'll talk.
I can't even manage myself.
Quiet is best on this floor.

lines.zh: 你问的这问题，找错对象了。
lines.en: You're asking the wrong creature.
Sitting here suits me fine.
I try to pick it up. My hand won't quite.
I nudge it aside.
I'll keep this button.
I pick up the loose thread.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我拿着也没用。
lines.en: No use to me, this.

lines.zh: 我把它搁回原来那块砖上。
lines.en: I set it back on the same tile.
I crouch slowly to reach it.
It fell. I look at it.
I lift it and put it back.
This doesn't belong here.
You moved, and I caught it.
I raise my head and turn toward you.
I stand here with no ill intent.
The door of this room is over there.
If you're leaving, I won't block the door.
I stand up. Only stand up.
Don't raise that thing.
I heard you shift your feet twice.

lines.zh: 就这样隔着几步，别靠近。
lines.en: Stay these few paces off. No closer.
This cloth of mine is stitched old.
I won't move. You don't either.

lines.zh: 在这角落，坐了很长时间。
lines.en: I've sat in this corner a long while.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，看着像铁的。
lines.en: That thing in your hand looks like iron.

lines.zh: 别围过来，我的线会绞紧。
lines.en: Don't surround me; my threads pull tight.
My threads have gone taut.
Don't come past this table.
I'm watching you. I won't come over.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，我的头就转到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my head follows.
The floor speaks. I hear it.
Your torchlight swept past.
I sit and watch you circle.
The only door is behind me.
You back to the corner, and I look away.
When I move, the threads whisper.
Your breathing's uneven.
I won't shout. There's no one to hear.
I sit back down. Slowly.

lines.zh: 你手别放在那个把手上。
lines.en: Keep your hand off that handle.

lines.zh: 这盏灯照不到我这角落。
lines.en: That lamp doesn't reach my corner.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚边很短。
lines.en: Your shadow at my feet is short.
I'll wait for you to go first.

lines.zh: 你每靠近一步，我就低一点头。
lines.en: Each step closer, I lower my head a little.
I don't like that sound.

lines.zh: 门都锁了，你只能面对我。
lines.en: Every door is locked; you face only me.
When you leave, I'll turn the light off.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步到门。
lines.en: I'm counting your steps to the door.
I raise my hand only to fend off your torch.
I only raise a hand, and you back off.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我才推了一下。
lines.en: You came at me, so I pushed once.

lines.zh: 这一下我的线挂住了你。
lines.en: That snagged my thread on you.
You back off and I withdraw at once.
I tap your hand. Lightly.

lines.zh: 这一下把你手里的东西打掉了。
lines.en: That knocked what you held away.

lines.zh: 我又坐回去，什么也没做。
lines.en: I sit back down. I did nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下我没有用力，只是挡住。
lines.en: I did not put force in it; I only blocked.
I won't chase. I sit.
That drove you back three full steps.
I straighten up and move no more.

lines.zh: 我挥手挡开，没什么力气。
lines.en: I wave it off. Little force in it.

lines.zh: 这一下我只想让你退开。
lines.en: That was only to move you back.
You swung, and I turned a little aside.
My sleeve brushes your face.
I've been in this room the whole time.

lines.zh: 有人把我摆在椅子上了。
lines.en: Someone set me on the chair.

lines.zh: 灯亮的时候，我就已经在了。
lines.en: I was here before the lights came on.

lines.zh: 这层楼很安静，我留下来了。
lines.en: This floor is quiet. I stayed.

lines.zh: 纸箱盖一开，我就坐起来。
lines.en: The box lid opens, and I sit up.

lines.zh: 我的线在地上拖了一点。
lines.en: My threads trail a little on the floor.

lines.zh: 门开着的时候，我站在门边。
lines.en: When the door was open, I stood beside it.
This patch of floor is where I sit.

lines.zh: 我慢慢坐下，没发出声音。
lines.en: I sit down slowly. No sound.
Someone brushed past me and left.

lines.zh: 我在这层楼待了一个月。
lines.en: I've been on this floor a month.

lines.zh: 影子先落到墙上，我才动。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the wall before I move.
There's a bundle of cloth in the corner. That's me.

lines.zh: 我坐在这张椅子上很久了。
lines.en: I've sat in this chair a long while.

lines.zh: 有人进门时把我碰了一下。
lines.en: Someone brushed me on the way in.
I come from the bottom shelf.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的灯，是我关的。
lines.en: I'm the one who turned off this room's light.
I settle on the windowsill and sit.

lines.zh: 楼上传来脚步，我抬了头。
lines.en: Steps upstairs. I lifted my head.

lines.zh: 我一直坐在这儿，没动过。
lines.en: I've sat here and never moved.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的布边卷起来。
lines.en: Fire curls my cloth's edge.

lines.zh: 我从椅子上掉下来，躺在那儿。
lines.en: I fall off the chair and lie there.

lines.zh: 水灌进棉花，我越来越重。
lines.en: Water fills the cotton and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推到墙角，棉花散了一地。
lines.en: The blast throws me to the corner, fluff everywhere.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我，卡在布里。
lines.en: Something sticks in me, caught in the cloth.

lines.zh: 有股力按住我，我动不了。
lines.en: A force pins me still.

lines.zh: 我不用吃东西，所以还撑得住。
lines.en: I don't need food, so I last.

lines.zh: 电击穿我，我的线全竖起来。
lines.en: A shock runs through and my threads bristle.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，布在黑暗里摊开。
lines.en: I fall, cloth spreading in the dark.
